[[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] '''Peters''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served in the [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Peters, along with [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Dregg (Human)|Dregg]] and [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Ta (individual)|Ta]], was stationed on Ord Mantell during a [[Separatist War|civil war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He was stationed in the [[Avilatan Badlands]], where the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] planted unexploded [[Mortar/Legends|mortar]] shells. He and Ta were ordered by Dregg to devise a life-or-death game of chance in the region. They were forced to challenge refugees in the area to run the mines and gather three unexploded shells.<ref name="TOR" />
